title: Black and White Tree
statementMd:
The board has got a painted tree graph, consisting of $*n*$ nodes. Let us remind you that a non-directed graph is called a tree if it is connected and doesn't contain any cycles.

Each node of the graph is painted black or white in such a manner that there aren't two nodes of the same color, connected by an edge. Each edge contains its value written on it as a non-negative integer.

A bad boy Vasya came up to the board and wrote number $*s*_{*v*}$ near each node $*v*$ — the sum of values of all edges that are incident to this node. Then Vasya removed the edges and their values from the board.

Your task is to restore the original tree by the node colors and numbers $*s*_{*v*}$.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of nodes in the tree. Next $*n*$ lines contain pairs of space-separated integers $*c*_{*i*}$, $*s*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 1$, $0 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$), where $*c*_{*i*}$ stands for the color of the $*i*$-th vertex (0 is for white, 1 is for black), and $*s*_{*i*}$ represents the sum of values of the edges that are incident to the $*i*$-th vertex of the tree that is painted on the board.

## Output

Print the description of $*n* - 1$ edges of the tree graph. Each description is a group of three integers $*v*_{*i*}$, $*u*_{*i*}$, $*w*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *v*_{*i*}, *u*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $*v*_{*i*} ≠ *u*_{*i*}$, $0 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$), where $*v*_{*i*}$ and $*u*_{*i*}$ — are the numbers of the nodes that are connected by the $*i*$-th edge, and $*w*_{*i*}$ is its value. Note that the following condition must fulfill $*c*_{*v*_{*i*}} ≠ *c*_{*u*_{*i*}}$.

It is guaranteed that for any input data there exists at least one graph that meets these data. If there are multiple solutions, print any of them. You are allowed to print the edges in any order. As you print the numbers, separate them with spaces.
statementZhMd:
棋盘上画着一棵树图，由 $*n*$ 个节点组成。我们提醒你，无向图被称为树，当且仅当它是连通的且不包含任何环。

图中的每个节点都被涂成黑色或白色，并且不存在两个颜色相同且由一条边相连的节点。每条边上都写有一个非负整数作为其权值。

一个名叫 Vasya 的坏孩子来到棋盘前，在每个节点 $*v*$ 旁边写下了数字 $*s*_{*v*}$，表示与该节点相 incident 的所有边的权值之和。随后，Vasya 从棋盘上擦去了所有边及其权值。

你的任务是根据节点的颜色和数字 $*s*_{*v*}$，还原原来的树。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示树中节点的数量。接下来的 $*n*$ 行每行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*c*_{*i*}$、$*s*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 1$，$0 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），其中 $*c*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 个顶点的颜色（0 表示白色，1 表示黑色），$*s*_{*i*}$ 表示棋盘上所画树中与第 $*i*$ 个顶点相 incident 的所有边的权值之和。

## 输出格式

输出树图的 $*n* - 1$ 条边。每条边用三个整数 $*v*_{*i*}$、$*u*_{*i*}$、$*w*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *v*_{*i*}, *u*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*v*_{*i*} ≠ *u*_{*i*}$，$0 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）描述，其中 $*v*_{*i*}$ 和 $*u*_{*i*}$ 是第 $*i*$ 条边所连接的两个节点的编号，$*w*_{*i*}$ 是该边的权值。注意，必须满足条件 $*c*_{*v*_{*i*}} ≠ *c*_{*u*_{*i*}}$。

保证对于任意输入数据，都至少存在一个满足这些数据的图。如果有多个解，输出任意一个即可。可以按任意顺序输出这些边。输出数字时，请使用空格分隔。
